title: Degree-zero extraction from the global dualizing comparison
statement: Given an isomorphism of the global integral dualizing Hom functor with the coefficient dual of the compact-support sections functor, its component at one constructible object yields the displayed degree-zero Hom equivalence from that object into the prescribed integral dualizing object.

source.place: Second proof paragraph; derived global-Hom comparison followed by degree-zero sections and the coefficient-point equivalence.

proof.text: Take the component of the supplied global isomorphism at K. Use the normalized zeroth-Hom comparison for the completed coefficient sheaf and the coefficient-point sections equivalence, whose value on the point unit is the displayed unit object. Compose the resulting additive equivalences and transport along the component isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Second proof paragraph; degree-zero extraction after the global mapping-limit comparison.

from.place: Degree-zero extraction from the global mapping-limit comparison.

lean.statement: theorem integralDualizing_mapping_limit_hom_at_degree_zero (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (η : integralDualizingGlobalHom l E X M.obj ≅ (integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙ coefficientDerivedDual (integralDualizingCoefficients l E)) : Nonempty ((K.obj ⟶ M.obj) ≃ ((integralDualizingLimit l E (Spec (.of D.k))).obj ((integralDualizingCompactTower l E D hl X).obj K.obj) ⟶ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (scalarReductionSource l E (Spec (.of D.k))) 0).obj (SheafOfModules.unit (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (Spec (.of D.k))))))
